answer: The atlas index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the delta queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 153 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the sable. A 186 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
